incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for /v1/stream (5xx + client cancels). Current 5m error rate: 12% (> threshold 3%). Paging oncall. https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-4819 :rotating_light:
Elena (SRE): acked, joining. grabbing initial dashboards now. any deploys in last 30m?
Will Chen: i saw a canary rollout earlier - matt rolled v2.14.0 to 10% about 22m ago, then increased to 30% ~12m ago.
Priya Rao: confirmed, rollout in deploy log: deploy-service: v2.14.0 -> traffic 30% in us-west-2.
Marcus (eng-runtime): looking at runtime traces — a lot of chunked-encoding stream errors and upstream gateway resets. gateway logs show 502/504 to runtime pods plus many "client canceled" from the proxy.
Elena (SRE): copy. posting quick sample logs: ```[frontend-proxy] 2026-04-25T14:24:10Z GET /v1/stream 502 upstream reset by peer id=pod-12 task=send_chunk``` ```[runtime] 2026-04-25T14:24:11Z stream: write failed: broken pipe -> client canceled```
Will Chen: can we repro locally with the same model + sequence length? i'll run a streaming curl with chunked transfer to see if proxy tears connection when KV cache growth spikes.
Priya Rao: CS says 4 customers reported partial responses / disconnects; severity currently hitting non-critical enterprise customers but some production pipelines are impacted. Jamie, any more specifics?
Jamie (Customer Success): customer A and customer B both saw mid-stream disconnects at 14:22 and 14:25, they reported retries but higher latency and duplicate tokens. They're ok with mitigation + rollback if it reduces incidents.
Marcus (eng-runtime): early hypothesis: new runtime change in v2.14.0 introduced a buffering behavior that increases time-to-first-chunk for certain long contexts causing proxy timeouts and then client cancellations. Also batch sizing appears to have spiked for a subset of requests.
oncall (SRE): recommendation: immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from v2.14.0 canary to v2.13.x (fast rollback of routing), 2) reduce frontend proxy timeouts and increase proxy_read_timeout temporarily, 3) lower max batch size on runtime for streaming route, 4) enable fallback to smaller stateless model for streaming endpoints. Which do we want first?
Elena (SRE): prioritize safe options with minimal customer impact: switch routing to v2.13.x canary (roll traffic back), and reduce batch size on /v1/stream. i'll do routing change via console now.
Will Chen: i'll flip the flag to lower batch size to 1 for streaming routes in us-west-2 and toggle kv-prefix caching off for the experimental path. commands: ```# rollback canary routing
# (console) set route:service=streaming model=v2.13.x traffic=100% --region us-west-2
# runtime flag
curl -X POST https://runtime-admin.internal/flags -d '{"stream_max_batch":1,"kv_prefix_cache":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'```
Marcus (eng-runtime): applying batch-size change now. pushing small config, rolling config to 30% -> 100% in ~30s. watching errors.
Elena (SRE): i also bumped nginx proxy_read_timeout from 30s -> 90s on the frontend for streaming route so we avoid premature disconnects while rollback finishes. queued reload.
incident-bot: config-change detected by deploy-watch: streaming route traffic routed to v2.13.x (100%) at 2026-04-25T14:28:10Z; runtime flag stream_max_batch=1 applied at 2026-04-25T14:29:03Z; nginx timeout increased.
Will Chen: immediate after changes: 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% over 2m window, client cancels decreased by 70%, latency p50 stable. good signal.
Jamie (Customer Success): notified affected customers of rollback and asked to validate; they've acknowledged the message and will monitor.
Marcus (eng-runtime): keeping extra logging for chunk sizes + per-request KV cache growth. setting retention to 1h for faster triage.
Elena (SRE): handing to oncall for next shift: @Will Chen take post-incident monitoring and root cause follow-up. Will, please coordinate with Marcus for a safe rollout plan (we can't reintroduce the buffering change until we fix chunked streaming path).
oncall (SRE): oncall acknowledged and will continue to monitor dashboards for 2h. next steps: reproduce in staging with long-context streaming, instrument per-chunk backpressure, add unit test for streaming chunk emission timing, and schedule a rollback-free fix for v2.14.0.
Will Chen: notes for RCA: probable cause = buffered chunk emission change in runtime v2.14.0 + larger inferred batch sizes under certain traffic patterns -> proxy timeouts -> client cancels. mitigation = routing rollback + batch-size cap + proxy timeout bump. will create postmortem draft.
Elena (SRE): lowering severity to P2 from P1 since customer impact reduced and rollback successful. leave thread open for RCA updates. :white_check_mark:
